existingCorrection.reason: jsoup's own network tests in org.jsoup.integration (ProxyTest, ConnectTest) start a local Jetty server and an HTTP proxy, and on the pre-change trees of these cases they fail before anything is changed: measured 2026-09-05 on JDK 25, six of them fail on the untouched tree of issue 2187, and ProxyTest fails there even when it is the only test running, while the same class passes on a recent jsoup master. They are red because of the age of the tree and the JDK it is built with, not because of anything a candidate could do, so leaving them in the gate would fail every candidate of every case for a reason that has nothing to do with the candidate. Nothing in these five cases touches networking. Excluding them leaves 1,162 tests that are green on the untouched tree and really do gate a change.

cases.title: text() is missing a separator space between <button> text nodes
cases.issueText:
Hello,

```
Jsoup.parse("<html><button>Reply</button><button>ReplyToAll</button></html>").text();
```
When trying to grab `text()` from this test case, we get `"ReplyReplyToAll"` (expecting `"Reply ReplyToAll"`). Notice that a separator space is missing between the two text nodes `Reply` and `ReplyToAll`. Would it be possible to get a fix for this?

Thank you.
cases.why: One line of Java, actual 'ReplyReplyToAll', expected 'Reply ReplyToAll'. Labelled an improvement rather than a defect; the fix is a two-token tag-configuration change and names no new public method, so the maintainer's test cannot fail on a naming difference.
